newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta Wheat Pool posts fy 1996 net of C$28 mln.
newsitem.headline: Alberta Wheat Pool posts fy 1996 net of C$28 mln.

text.p: Alberta Wheat Pool on Friday posted net earnings of C$28.2 milllion for the year ended July 31, 1996, compared to C$6.9 million the year before, an AWP statement said.
AWP's board of directors will recommend at the grain handler's November annual meeting it pay a dividend of C$19.8 million to the cooperative's 57,000 farmer-owners.
Revenues from AWP's grain and agricultural businesses rose more than four percent to C$2.13 billion from C$2.04 billion.
World commodity price rises account for the higher revenues.
The amount of grain AWP shipped in 1995/96 (Aug/July) declined to 5.5 million tonnes from 6.4 million tonnes the year before.
Gross margin rose 4.4 percent to C$244 million from C$234 million the year before.
AWP raised C$100 million in the last fiscal year in a long-term debt offering to upgrade and build new facilities.
